634:t_2:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(You're going to change. In place of me, who couldn't.)

634:t_2:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm sorry I made you worry... You, $$フェルト$$, and everyone else...」

634:t_3:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「So this is... the core of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!」

634:t_3:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm activating the $$クアンタムシステム$$.」

634:t_3:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Can you hear me, $$ヒイロ$$! I'm going to link your Gundam's $$ゼロシステム$$ with $$ヴェーダ$$!」

634:t_3:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You're the one who will handle the torrent of information from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

634:t_3:12.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If it goes through $$ヴェーダ$$ and the $$ゼロシステム$$, you can receive information from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ even without the ability to receive $$脳量子波$$.」

634:t_3:13.en:
$$刹那$$
「Wait, $$ティエリア$$! That information destroyed even my brain! If $$ヒイロ$$ takes it...!」

634:t_3:16.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't worry. Unlike you, I'm used to shutting out the extraneous noise around me.」

634:t_3:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Originally, the $$ゼロシステム$$ was supposed to be mounted on the Gundam built for dialogue and linked to $$ヴェーダ$$.」

634:t_3:19.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But someone who left $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ built it into the $$ウイングゼロ$$.」

634:t_3:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「To complete $$イオリア$$'s plan, the Gundam that was split in two has to be made one.」

634:t_3:21.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... If it's you, who has mastered the $$ゼロシステム$$, you should be able to fulfill that role together with $$刹那$$.」

634:t_3:27.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$クアンタム・バースト$$!!」

634:t_3:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「This... is the start of a dialogue with humanity's survival at stake!」

634:t_3:33.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll take on all the extraneous stuff...! You... take in their feelings...!」

634:t_3:42.en:
$$クラウス$$
「They should be fighting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ right now, though...」

634:t_3:45.en:
$$マリナ$$
「He is... trying to come to an understanding with them.」

634:t_4:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ came together and turned into a flower, and...」

634:t_4:6.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Are you saying they wrapped up the black hole...!?」

634:t_4:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ understood us, and saved the Earth.」

634:t_4:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「Something that beautiful was born. The fighting's over now, isn't it.」

634:t_4:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「In that moment, I touched the consciousness of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too.」

634:t_4:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their home planet was about to die, and they were searching for a way to survive...」

634:t_4:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ don't have a will in each individual; the whole swarm has a single will, doesn't it...」

634:t_4:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「They were connected through $$脳量子波$$ and kept the whole swarm in order.」

634:t_4:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then they attacked people with $$脳量子波$$ because they were trying to communicate...」

634:t_4:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By connecting... by becoming one, they were trying to understand each other, weren't they...」

634:t_4:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The reason we were able to coexist with the $$バジュラ$$ must be that their ecology was similar.」

634:t_4:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And now... they've come to understand humanity.」

634:t_4:20.en:
$$シン$$
「Yes! It's the flower $$マリナ$$ gave to $$刹那$$!」

634:t_4:21.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「By sharing consciousness with $$刹那$$, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gave form to the image of peace inside him.」

634:t_4:22.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But $$刹那$$ and $$ヒイロ$$ are...」

634:t_4:24.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look, everyone! The middle of the flower!」

634:t_4:25.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've confirmed the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ and the $$ウイングゼロ$$! Both units are safe!」

634:t_4:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're one tough guy, $$ヒイロ$$!」

634:t_4:30.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even so, that guy did well to take in an $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will that would destroy even $$刹那$$'s mind.」

634:t_4:31.en:
$$カトル$$
「So he had the Heart of Space after all.」

634:t_4:33.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space... It's a phrase the leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$ used, something people need in order to live in this universe.」

634:t_4:34.en:
$$カトル$$
「There are many interpretations, but I think it's a heart that understands others and accepts them.」

634:t_4:35.en:
$$タケル$$
「If people could do that, there'd be no more conflict.」

クアンタムシステム.evidence: 00 Qan[T]'s system (Quantum System) activated by Setsuna before Quantum Burst; not in glossary sheet; fits sibling keyword クアンタム・バースト / ゼロシステム

634:t_4:30: subject 奴 = Heero, made explicit as 'that guy'
